temporal_scope: Four exact March/June/September/December15,2022 snapshots,not means or annual extrema.

source_metadata_conflict.original_value: Two exact00Z snapshots, January15 and July15,2022. Not monthly means, seasonal envelopes, annual extrema or independent occupation observations.
source_metadata_conflict.resolution: snapshot_times_utc and all original case timestamps govern; stale January/July prose is retained as a conflict,not used as dates.

method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear transverse strips;native first-to-last minimum support where a boundary is censored. Original core windows select cores without imposing layer limits or detachment.
layer_metric_interpretation: Lower depth is absolute positive model depth;thickness is lower minus upper. Search strata do not force isolated current identity or physical body limits.
minimum_span_interpretation: Conditional native minimum support under original piecewise-linear signed-component definition,not a physical named-current thickness bound. Single-level zero is uninformative,not absence.
range_interpretation: Native-bracket conditional geometry scenarios,not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals or annual envelopes.
axis_anchor_interpretation: Original model-selected axis proxies only;one Antilles gap remains null. No replacement core,date,gate,branch,source stratum or between-section interpolation.
interpretation: Loop partial northward limb only,not closed-loop/return limb/rings/Florida. Antilles local Bahamas/Abaco reach only,not whole Antilles,Gulf Stream,DWBC or detached eddies. Same-sign mesoscale flow can connect;no independent current-body identification,flow-normal width,terrain clearance,whole-route depth or physical water volume.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU;original source fields and qualifiers retained.
run_note: Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.
